title: IIO to probe teen's death
article: The B.C. Coroners Service and the Independent Investigations Office are investigating the death of a 18-year-old woman who died after spending a night in RCMP cells.
The coroners service has identified the teen as Jocelyn Nynah Marsha George, 18, of Port Alberni.
George was taken into custody by the Port Alberni RCMP on Thursday and kept in a jail cell overnight. She was found Friday morning in need of medical attention, the coroners service said.
She was transported by B.C. Ambulance Service to hospital in Port Alberni, then flown to hospital in Victoria, where she died that night.
